import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
x = np.arange(len(survival_pivot.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax1.bar(x - width/2, survival_pivot['female'], width, label='Female', color='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax1.bar(x + width/2, survival_pivot['male'], width, label='Male', color='#4ECDC4', alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(survival_pivot.index)
ax1.legend()
ax1.set_ylim([0, 1])
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                f'{height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
class_order = ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
df_filtered = df[df['class'].isin(class_order)].copy()
df_filtered['Survived'] = df_filtered['survived'].map({0: 'Died', 1: 'Survived'})
sns.violinplot(data=df_filtered, x='class', y='fare', hue='Survived', 
               split=True, ax=ax3, order=class_order, palette={'Died': '#E74C3C', 'Survived': '#2ECC71'})
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylim([0, 300])
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival rate by embarkation port and class
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'class'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
embark_survival = embark_survival[embark_survival['embark_town'].notna()]
embark_pivot = embark_survival.pivot(index='embark_town', columns='class', values='survived')
embark_pivot = embark_pivot.reindex(['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown'])
embark_pivot = embark_pivot[['First', 'Second', 'Third']]
embark_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FFD93D', '#6BCB77', '#4D96FF'], alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port and Class', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.legend(title='Class', title_fontsize=9, fontsize=8)
ax4.set_ylim([0, 1])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
